summary: Add on-demand, read-only retrieval of a single durable Task's complete detail through the existing TaskStore and Task Frontier registry. Preserve retrieval-only semantics: no new state store, no new lifecycle or authorization state machine, and no automatic prompt injection.

components.disposition: Reuse TaskStore.get and the existing task registry. Add task_get as an opt-in model-callable read view for full acceptance, done_when, blocked_reason, evidence refs and task metadata. It does not write task state, decide task semantics, add a new authority, or inject task data into ordinary prompts.
components.verification_level: Independent GLM-5.3 Reviewer PASS, P0=0/P1=0; focused 42 tests passed; original bash scripts/ci_gate.sh --release exit 0 with Ruff/Pyright complete, Vitest 600 passed, tier0 341 passed, serial_signal 7 passed, serial_perf 3 passed, and full parallel pytest 14631 passed/158 skipped/3 xfailed.
components.model_evidence_veto_recovery_exit: The model chooses whether and when to call task_get. If full detail is unnecessary it can use existing task_frontier or do no task lookup. No task data is forced into the prompt; the read result is evidence for the model, not a program-owned completion or priority decision.
components.rollback_route: Revert the task_get feature commit. The change adds no persistent task records and does not migrate or rewrite existing task data.
